Name: MoreSecretNotes
Author: NotAGardener
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/ketvxnM.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[font=Arial][size=3]Found all the secret notes and you are craving some more mystery and collectibles?
This mod adds 14 new secret notes across the land of Stardew Valley including 1 new hat, hints to game lore, notes that give you rewards based on game progress and more!

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]Please mind that you do still need the magnifying glass item to find these secret notes.

[/size][/font][size=3]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to be able to function. An optional mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to configure if you want to be able to get secret notes that give you money or not.﻿﻿﻿﻿[/size][/center]
[center][size=5]Special thanks to IchorTower and Decidedlyhuman for the frameworks that made this mod possible![/size][/center]
